pre.text: ✅ Directions : You will be listening to ATC instructions and making calls of your own. Most questions ask you to do **more than read back** — count what the instruction asks for before you answer. Some questions continue from the question before, so keep your notes. Your callsign is HL123. "Say again (=Repeat)" available once only. * Response time for each question : 20 or 30 seconds, as shown

body.text: Ravenglass / HOLNE TWO departure

body.label: Delivery
body.text: HL123, cleared to Ravenglass via the HOLNE TWO departure, flight level three one zero, squawk four six two one.
Dispatch has just told you that at today's weight you cannot reach flight level three one zero until one hour after departure. You want flight level two seven zero first.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, say again your cleared level and your squawk.
Answer both of his questions, and report what you cannot do with a reason.
You are in moderate turbulence. **Your turbulence penetration speed is two seven zero knots and you must not go faster than that.**

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, increase speed to three one zero knots for spacing.
Give a full readback, and tell him what you can do instead.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, behind the departing Airbus A330, line up and wait runway two seven, behind.
The A330 has departed and you are lined up. The first officer tells you the brake temperature on the left main gear is still above the limit for takeoff and needs two more minutes to cool.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, wind two four zero at eight, cleared for takeoff runway two seven.
Give a full readback, tell him what you cannot do with a reason, and tell him how long you need.
Kinloch Approach / BRAXO
Report your status and make a request.
The passenger is still restrained and the crew are managing him, so you are willing to go to a normal stand. You have three people involved — the passenger and the two holding him.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, descend to one one thousand, turn right heading zero two zero, vectors for Kinloch. How many people are involved, and do you need us to keep you away from the terminal?
Give a full readback, and answer both of his questions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, cross BRAXO at or below flight level one five zero, reduce speed to two five zero knots.
You are passing flight level one niner zero and your present descent profile will put you at flight level one seven zero at BRAXO. You need descent now to make the restriction.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, say again your present level.
Answer his question, tell him what you were told to do at BRAXO, and tell him what you need.
Barnsdale Tower

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, Barnsdale RVR runway two seven is 500 metres. Say your intentions.
Respond with a reason, and say what you want.

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In each question you are given **one of your own limits.** Read it carefully — sometimes it is a **maximum** and sometimes it is a **minimum**, and the controller sometimes asks for something you can accept. **Decide, say why, and give the controller both figures.** One question continues from the question before. Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 20 or 30 seconds, as shown

body.text: **Your maximum approach speed at today's landing weight is one six zero knots.**

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, maintain one eight zero knots to four miles. Can you do that?
Respond accordingly with a reason.
**Your maximum tailwind for takeoff is one zero knots.**

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, runway zero niner, wind two seven zero at eight. Can you accept?
Respond accordingly with a reason.
**The shortest runway you can use at today's landing weight is 2,600 metres.**

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, runway three two has 2,300 metres available. Can you take it?
Respond accordingly with a reason.
**Your required landing distance today is 2,100 metres.** You have no reason to stay airborne.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, runway two seven has 2,300 metres available, and it saves you one one minutes. Can you take it?
Respond accordingly with a reason.
HOLNE

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, maintain Mach decimal seven eight or greater until HOLNE.
**At your present weight and temperature your maximum cruise Mach number is Mach decimal seven six.**

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, confirm you can maintain that Mach number until HOLNE?
Respond accordingly, with both figures and a reason.
**Your maximum crosswind on a contaminated runway is one five knots.** The runway is contaminated with slush. Runway zero eight is clear of slush and into wind, but it is eight minutes of taxi back.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, runway one four, wind zero eight zero at two zero. Say your intentions.
Respond accordingly with a reason, and say what you want.
Barnsdale / Haverly

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Barnsdale runway two two has 2,400 metres but you'd be two two minutes. Haverly has 3,000 metres, nine minutes. What would you like?
Respond accordingly with a reason, and say what you want.

sections.title: 약점 C. 값 유지 — 되묻기 롤플레이

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In Part C you will be interacting with an Air traffic controller through ten turns. **The controller will ask you for your figures later in the scenario, and some of them will have changed by then.** Follow the prompts and respond as necessary. "Say again (=Repeat)" available only once. Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 30 seconds or less

Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, level at flight level two three zero, 55 miles from TURLO, inbound to Kinloch Airport. Your fuel endurance is two hours two zero minutes and there are one five seven persons on board. Your required landing distance is 2,000 metres, and with your present flap setting your maximum speed is two five zero knots.

body.text: Kinloch Approach / TURLO
Contact Kinloch Approach, report your position and level, and request descent.
BRAXO ONE arrival
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and inquire about the landing distance available.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Kinloch Approach, descend to one one thousand, expect the BRAXO ONE arrival, ILS runway two seven. Be advised, there is work in progress at the far end of the runway.

pre.text: Situation Update Passing one three thousand feet you get a STABILIZER TRIM JAM caption. The trim is stuck and your flaps are now limited to one five. Your approach speed goes up, so **your required landing distance is now 2,900 metres**, and with the trim in this condition **you must not exceed one niner zero knots from now on.** You want to level off at one one thousand and you want a long final so that you can fly it slowly.

body.text: Report your problem to the controller, tell him both things that have changed, and make a request with a reason.
Kinloch / Ravenglass / landing distance available
Listen to the controller, state your decision with a reason, and tell him the figure you need.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, with the work in progress Kinloch runway two seven gives you 2,700 metres. Ravenglass has 3,200 metres and it's one three minutes away. What would you like?
Listen to the controller and provide the requested information.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, I'm coordinating with Ravenglass. Say your fuel endurance and the number of persons on board.
Ravenglass Approach
Listen to the controller, give a full readback and say your intentions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn left heading two eight zero, descend to 9,000 feet, vectors for Ravenglass, contact Ravenglass Approach on 125.25. Say your intentions.
You are now with a new controller who has none of your figures. Listen to him and answer both of his questions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Ravenglass Approach, radar contact. I've got nothing on you — say the landing distance you need and the number of persons on board.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and tell him whether you can do that with a reason.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn right heading three four zero, descend to 5,000 feet, reduce speed to two one zero knots until eight miles. Can you do that speed?

pre.text: Situation Update The trim is still jammed and the flaps are still limited to one five. Nothing has changed.

body.text: Listen to the controller and answer both of his questions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, you've been working on it for a while now, so I take it the trim has freed up. Is that right, and do you still need the full length?
Ravenglass Tower
Listen to the controller, give a full readback, and say what you will need on the runway.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn left heading zero one zero, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway two two approach, contact Ravenglass Tower on 118.30.

sections.title: 약점 D. 발신 — 기관 호출 · REQUEST + 명사구

pre.text: ✅ Directions : In Part D you usually call first, with **no controller transmission.** Each situation tells you exactly what you want — **read it to the end before you speak.** One question continues from the question before. Your callsign is HL123. * Response time for each question : 20 seconds or less

body.text: Marlow Control / TURLO
Report your situation and make a request.
Kinloch Delivery / CASTO THREE departure / HOLNE TWO departure
Report your situation and make a request.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, taxi to holding point Quebec two via Mike and Papa, give way to the Boeing 787 crossing ahead of you.

You have given way to the 787 and you are approaching Papa. The ground crew call you on the interphone — a panel on the left engine cowl was left unlatched and they have only just seen it. You must go back to the stand. **You are already with Ground.**
Report your status and make a request.
Ravenglass Approach
Report your status and make a request with a reason.
Barnsdale Tower
Report your status and make a request.
Marlow Control / TURLO
Make a report.

pre.text: ✅ Directions : You will be asked four questions about Part C. **You have up to 90 seconds for each.** Answer every part of the question, and finish the part that asks for an example.

body.text: Follow up question.

In this situation, two of your figures changed and one of them came back a second time. Which figures changed, and what did you have to compare them with? In your role as a pilot, what do you write down when a figure is replaced, so that the old one cannot come out of your mouth later? Give an example.
Follow up question.

In this situation, the controller assumed your problem had been fixed when it had not. Why is it dangerous to let an assumption like that stand, even for one transmission? From your own experiences, how do you tell a controller that nothing has changed without sounding as though you are repeating yourself? Give an example.
